map.根据体重、活动水平和目标计算每日蛋白质推荐摄入量: Calculate your daily recommended protein intake from weight, activity level and goal
map.需求量(g) = 体重(kg) × 活动系数（目标取下限：增肌 ≥1.6、减脂: Requirement (g) = weight (kg) × activity factor (goal takes the lower bound: muscle gain ≥1.6, fat loss ≥1.8, recovery ≥1.5, elderly ≥1.2)
map.年龄 ≥ 65 岁再按老年下限取高值: If age ≥ 65, take the higher value of the elderly lower bound
map.参考来源：中国居民膳食营养素参考摄入量 (DRIs)、国际运动营养学会 (ISS: Sources: Chinese Dietary Reference Intakes (DRIs), International Society of Sports Nutrition (ISSN)
map.• 动物蛋白：鸡蛋、牛奶、鱼虾、鸡胸肉、瘦牛肉（氨基酸模式好，吸收率高）: • Animal protein: eggs, milk, fish and shrimp, chicken breast, lean beef (good amino acid profile, high absorption)
map.• 植物蛋白：大豆及制品、藜麦、坚果、豆类（需搭配互补）: • Plant protein: soy and soy products, quinoa, nuts, legumes (combine for complementary amino acids)
map.• 均匀分配到三餐：每餐20-40g优质蛋白效果最佳: • Distribute evenly across meals: 20-40 g of quality protein per meal works best
map.• 训练后30-60分钟：蛋白质合成窗口，利于肌肉修复: • 30-60 minutes after training: the protein synthesis window, good for muscle repair
map.• 睡前：缓释蛋白（如酪蛋白）可减少夜间肌肉分解: • Before bed: slow-release protein (e.g. casein) can reduce overnight muscle breakdown
map.• 肾功能不全者需遵医嘱限制蛋白质摄入: • People with renal impairment should limit protein intake as advised by a doctor
map.• 蛋白质摄入应配合力量训练才能增肌: • Protein intake must be combined with strength training to build muscle
map.• 不要依赖补剂，天然食物优先: • Do not rely on supplements; natural foods come first
map.• 高蛋白饮食需保证充足饮水: • A high-protein diet requires adequate water intake
map.⚠️ 本计算器仅供参考，不能替代专业营养师建议。特殊人群（肾病、肝病、痛风等）请: ⚠️ This calculator is for reference only and cannot replace the advice of a professional dietitian. Special groups (kidney disease, liver disease, gout, etc.) should follow medical advice.
map.普通健康成人：一般成年人约 0.8-1.0 g/kg/天即可满足基本需求；久坐人: Ordinary healthy adults: about 0.8-1.0 g/kg/day meets basic needs for most adults; sedentary people take the lower bound, and those with higher activity take 1.0-1.2.
map.运动 / 增肌人群：规律力量训练者建议 1.4-2.0 g/kg/天以保护肌肉、: Athletes / muscle-building: regular strength trainers are advised 1.4-2.0 g/kg/day to protect muscle and promote synthesis; during a fat-loss phase, raising it to 1.6-2.2 g/kg reduces muscle loss.
map.分餐摄入与供能占比：按每日总量分摊到 3-4 餐，每餐 25-40g 吸收利用更: Split intake and energy share: spread the daily total over 3-4 meals, with 25-40 g per meal for better absorption and use; protein provides 4 kcal per gram, and 15-25% of total calories is appropriate.
map.每日蛋白质 = 65 × 1.4 = 91 g，分摊到 3 餐约 30 g/餐；: Daily protein = 65 × 1.4 = 91 g, spread over 3 meals at about 30 g each; energy = 91 × 4 = 364 kcal (about 18% of 2000 kcal daily). The tool defaults to 1.4, giving 30 g per meal and 364 kcal.
map.蛋白质吃太多有上限吗？: Is there an upper limit to protein?
map.健康人群长期超过 2.5-3 g/kg/天并无额外收益，且增加肾脏代谢负担；已有: For healthy people, exceeding 2.5-3 g/kg/day long-term brings no extra benefit and increases the kidneys' metabolic burden; those with chronic kidney disease should limit it as advised by a doctor. Evenly split meals are used better than a single large dose.
map.植物蛋白和动物蛋白怎么选？: How do I choose between plant and animal protein?
map.动物蛋白（蛋奶肉鱼）氨基酸更完整；植物蛋白多缺个别必需氨基酸，建议谷物+豆类搭配: Animal protein (eggs, dairy, meat, fish) has a more complete amino acid profile; plant proteins often lack some essential amino acids, so combining grains with legumes is recommended. Vegetarians can meet the target by modestly increasing the total and diversifying sources.
